$comment: Advisories the dependency gate is allowed to pass over, and only these.
Policy and process live in security/README.md. Every entry is dated and
expires; scripts/check_audit_waivers.py fails CI when one does.
Each entry must also appear in auditConfig.ignoreGhsas in
pnpm-workspace.yaml, and the checker fails when the two disagree.

waivers.reason: Path traversal in @vitest/mocker's redirect mock, reachable only by a test file that already executes with full developer privileges in this repository, so it grants an attacker nothing they would not already have. Not in any shipped bundle: vitest is a devDependency of apps/web and never reaches a build artefact. The fix is vitest >=4.1.11 and we are on ^3.2.7, so it is a major upgrade rather than a patch, tracked separately. Waived so that `make gate` passes on a clean checkout, which CONTRIBUTING.md promises a new contributor.
